A voluminous glossy {argument name="jacket color" default="red"} leather jacket with a wide collar, partially unbuttoned, revealing the chest; one hand holding the edge of the jacket/zipper, shoulders turned, head tilted back, gaze directed upwards, ultra-detailed natural skin texture, sharp focus on the face, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, f/1.8.

Premium studio lighting: strong directional key light from the top left with a cool tint in the highlights and shadows, deep sculpted shadows on the neck and chin, barely visible contour light; warm orange-red gradient background, cinematic color grading.
